The visible skirt begins around y=92, spanning approximately x=80..820.
The left hem reaches approximately x=32 near y=260; the right hem reaches x=856 near y=270.

DESIGN: original dark muted plum-purple short pleated skirt, clean fine plum anime linework and soft restrained cel shading. Trace the reference's actual pleat layout and curved hem shape. The whole skirt including left strap/buckle must remain fully visible and unclipped.
BACKGROUND: perfectly flat saturated chroma GREEN near RGB 18,240,14 (#12F00E), including all space where hoodie/body/legs/bag were removed. No checkerboard, shadows, gradients, outlines around the canvas, text, labels, measurements or guide marks.
This is a faithful isolated sprite cleanup with a nearly straight skirt silhouette, not a new fashion illustration.
